name: kitland
description: Kitland — everyday developer tools, in one place. Tools out. Work on.
author: OutOf0 <hello.outof0@gmail.com>

scripts.package:check: pnpm --filter @kitland/browser-extension package:check && pnpm --filter kitland-tools package:smoke && pnpm --filter @kitland/mcp package:check
scripts.artifacts:all: pnpm --filter @kitland/browser-extension package:all && pnpm --filter kitland-tools package:vsix && pnpm --filter @kitland/mcp package
scripts.release:artifacts: pnpm build && pnpm artifacts:all && pnpm --filter @kitland/mcp package:check
scripts.quality:check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm audit --audit-level=high && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @kitland/web bundle:check && pnpm --filter @kitland/web seo:check && pnpm package:check && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.release:check: pnpm quality:check && pnpm release:verify && pnpm artifacts:check
scripts.release:preflight: pnpm release:check && pnpm test:integration:vscode && pnpm release:config:check
scripts.release:check:rollout: pnpm quality:check && pnpm release:verify:rollout && pnpm --filter @kitland/web rollout:artifact:check && pnpm --filter @kitland/web test:e2e:rollout
scripts.pages:deploy: pnpm release:check && wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name=kitland
scripts.pages:deploy:rollout: pnpm release:check:rollout && wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name=kitland
scripts.pages:dev: pnpm build:web && wrangler pages dev apps/web/dist
